rules.High: scene input/copy dependency OR HDRP character/SSS model OR >6 sampling sites OR >180 native nodes
rules.Medium: transparent OR vertex animation OR >2 sampling sites OR >55 native nodes
rules.HDRP: PC target only; no mobile support assertion
rules.OtherDevices: High -> PC; otherwise >4 sites -> Pad/PC; remaining -> Mobile/Pad/PC

notes: Sampling counts are static graph sites, not dynamic samples/instructions. Template lights, hidden samples, passes, resolution, overdraw and hardware are not measured.
